meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描项目中未被引用的代码(未用导入、变量、类型、孤立文件),用 LSP 引用检查确认零引用后再删除,按文件分批交给并行子代理处理,每批通过 typecheck 后单独提交一个 commit,最后给出移除清单。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词,或要求清理没用到的代码时接管。可给出文件路径、目录或符号名来限定扫描范围。

say.text: 帮我清理这个项目里的死代码
say.note: 先扫描并用 LSP 验证再删除

say.text: 只清理 src/utils.ts 里没被引用的代码
say.note: 用文件路径限定扫描范围

say.text: 只删掉 unusedFunc 这个符号

howto.what_en: Claude scans for unreferenced code (unused imports, variables, types, orphaned files), verifies zero references via LSP, then removes it in file-grouped batches, each committed as one atomic commit after typecheck passes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "remove dead code", "dead code" or "cleanup". A file path, directory or symbol name can narrow the scan.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project.
say_en.note: Scans, verifies with LSP, then removes

say_en.text: Only remove unreferenced code in src/utils.ts.
say_en.note: Limits the scan to that file
